Hero.description: Advanced electronics manufacturing, from development to the finished product. Our technological solutions serve a wide range of applications in the railway industry, healthcare, industrial automation and energy.

AboutHero.title: Your partner for electronics manufacturing and development
AboutHero.description: Since 1997, Hokami CZ s.r.o. has been one of the leading Czech providers of electronics manufacturing services (EMS). We offer comprehensive solutions from material sourcing and printed circuit board production through SMT and THT assembly and testing to final assembly, programming, conformal coating, potting and complete logistics.

AboutCampus.title: Campus
AboutCampus.description: Hokami Campus is also home to other companies and services that together create a modern environment for work and everyday life. The campus includes technology company Cleartex, dental clinic Dolident, café Dolicafe and coffee roastery DoodleBeans.

AboutHistory.title: From 1997 to the present
AboutHistory.description: Through long-term investment in the latest manufacturing technologies, automation and quality control, we can take full manufacturing responsibility for our customers’ electronic products. Using the technical documentation provided, we deliver finished products ready for immediate use or integration into final equipment.
AboutHistory.invitation: Explore the major milestones, technological advances and key moments that have shaped our company.
AboutHistory.conclusion: Electronics manufactured by Hokami are used in a wide range of demanding sectors, including industry, medical technology, energy, rail transport, consumer electronics, the automotive industry, aviation and space technology. Our solutions are part of equipment that customers around the world rely on every day.

SustainabilityHero.title: Sustainability
SustainabilityHero.description: At Hokami, we see sustainability as a natural part of modern electronics manufacturing and the long-term development of our company. Environmental responsibility, efficient use of resources and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes are firmly embedded in our day-to-day operations and strategic decisions. Our goal is to manufacture electronics with the utmost emphasis on quality, efficiency and minimising environmental impact.

SustainabilityEnergy.title: Energy efficiency and modern technology
SustainabilityEnergy.technology: We continuously invest in modern manufacturing technologies that help reduce energy consumption, optimise production processes and use materials more efficiently. Our investments also include regular upgrades to manufacturing equipment, the use of energy-efficient machinery, intelligent energy management and extensive use of LED lighting across our facilities.
SustainabilityEnergy.photovoltaics: Our own photovoltaic power plant supplies a significant share of the electricity consumed by the company, currently covering more than 60% of total consumption. By combining our own energy generation with modern technologies, we reduce the energy intensity of production over the long term and support the company's sustainable development.

SustainabilityProduction.title: Responsible manufacturing
SustainabilityProduction.processes: Our manufacturing processes are designed to meet the highest standards of quality, safety and environmental protection. We focus on efficient use of materials, minimising production losses and responsible handling of the waste we generate.
SustainabilityProduction.materials: Lead-free manufacturing processes, compliance with the requirements of the European RoHS and REACH directives, and safe handling of chemicals in accordance with applicable legislation are standard practice for us. All waste is carefully sorted and handed over to authorised partners for recycling or environmentally sound disposal.

supplyChain.title: A responsible supply chain
supplyChain.description: Sustainability extends beyond the factory. We work with trusted suppliers who share our requirements for quality, transparency and responsible business practices. When planning production and logistics, we strive to use transport capacity efficiently, optimise the supply chain and reduce unnecessary transport operations.

people.title: People and company culture
people.description: Employees are a key part of our approach. We promote an environment in which responsible behaviour is a natural part of everyday work. We regularly train employees in occupational safety, environmental protection and the proper handling of materials and waste. We also encourage employee initiatives that improve manufacturing processes, increase efficiency and reduce environmental impact.

improvement.title: Continuous improvement
improvement.description: We see sustainability as a long-term process rather than a one-off project. We therefore continually assess our manufacturing processes, invest in innovation and seek new opportunities to reduce energy intensity, use resources more efficiently and further develop responsible manufacturing.

SustainabilityContact.title: Looking for an electronics manufacturing partner?
SustainabilityContact.description: Our goal is to be a reliable partner for customers around the world and a company that contributes to the responsible development of the electronics industry. We believe that high manufacturing quality, technological innovation and environmental responsibility form the foundation of a sustainable business over the long term.

hero.title: SMT
hero.description: SMT (Surface Mount Technology) forms the foundation of modern electronics manufacturing and is one of Hokami’s key technologies. Drawing on many years of experience, advanced equipment and carefully controlled manufacturing processes, we produce electronic assemblies from prototypes to high-volume production. Our aim is to provide customers with reliable, flexible and high-quality manufacturing solutions that meet the requirements of a wide range of industries.

production.title: Four automated SMT lines
production.description: Production runs on four fully automated SMT lines using modern Yamaha and Assembleon placement technologies. The manufacturing process is controlled with an emphasis on maximum precision, repeatability and the quality of every assembled joint. We routinely work with manufacturing documentation supplied by the customer and, when needed, provide technical support to optimise product designs for series production (DFM).
production.imageAlt: An operator working at a machine on a HOKAMI SMT production line.

reflow.title: Reflow soldering
reflow.description: After the SMD components have been placed, reflow soldering creates high-quality solder joints with lasting reliability. Our reflow ovens allow precise control of temperature profiles for both lead-free and leaded soldering, ensuring high manufacturing quality even for technologically demanding electronic assemblies. Our modern soldering technologies enable us to process a wide range of products, from standard industrial applications to electronics with stringent quality and reliability requirements.
reflow.imageAlt: A close-up of a printed circuit board and component feeders in a placement machine.

dimensions.title: Board dimensions
dimensions.description: Our equipment can assemble printed circuit boards measuring up to 810 × 480 mm. Regular investment in manufacturing technology and automation enables us to respond flexibly to individual customer requirements and deliver technically demanding projects.

capacity.title: Production capacity
capacity.description: Our current production capacity exceeds 40 million SMT placements per month, allowing us to handle prototypes, medium-sized series and high-volume orders efficiently while maintaining high quality and short lead times.

express.title: Express production
express.description: For time-critical projects, we also offer an express manufacturing service, with production able to start within 24 hours of receiving the complete manufacturing documentation.

bonding.title: Wire bonding
bonding.description: Our technological capabilities also include gold-wire bonding, aluminium-wire bonding and Glob Top technology, enabling specialised applications that require advanced methods of interconnecting semiconductor components.

contact.title: Looking for an electronics manufacturing partner?
contact.description: By combining modern SMT technologies, precisely controlled reflow soldering, an experienced team and rigorous quality control, we offer customers comprehensive electronics manufacturing solutions focused on maximum reliability, flexibility and the long-term quality of finished products.
